verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a synchronous authorization webhook for real-time approve/decline decisions and attaches ML risk scores (fraud, merchant dispute risk, card testing) to every authorization, which is some decision-grade context on the event. Spending controls can act on merchant categories, merchant IDs and card presence, which implies that data exists, but that is an adjacent control and does not show the fields are carried on the authorization payload. Missing for 10: documented merchant name/MCC fields on the authorization event, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
